title: Cop accused of abusing ex-partner remains in service despite 7 complaints

blocks.text: A woman who accused her former live-in partner, a police officer, of years of physical, psychological and economic abuse has sought the intervention of the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM), saying he remains in active service despite seven complaints filed against him.
